title: Take on an undercover mission at the Spy Museum
description: At Washington’s International Spy Museum, take a cover identity and test your observation and decision-making as you move through the exhibits. Real artifacts and stories show how espionage has worked across eras; the interactive mission keeps you alert to small details. Leave time to compare the fictional spy in your head with the messier reality on display.
teaser: Try a cover identity while exploring real spy history.
goodToKnow: Playful indoor experience; allow breaks through the extensive galleries.
whyItMightDelightYou: The mission makes you an active observer as the exhibits challenge familiar spy myths.
